title: MV Stat changes for equipment in shop menu for a single actor.

posts.author: Tamarin
posts.body:
I am making a single actor game in RPG Maker MV and I need a simple change to the window in the shop menu that shows stat changes for actors with different equipment.  This is what it looks like by default:
As it is, it doesn't specify which stat will be increased or decreased by the equipment and there's a lot of extra space reserved for additional actors which my game won't have.  I want to change this window so it just shows all the stats for the one actor in my game and how they change with different pieces of equipment.  In other words, make it like the stats window in the equip menu.
So the new stats window in the shop menu would have to look like this:
I've searched for other shop menu plugins but they either don't have this function that I'm looking for or they come with other unnecessary features that can't be disabled.
